My first book I read was the Tripod series. I still remember the exhilaration I felt in the notion of fighting against a large powerful enemy. The fight is not unlike what we face albeit in the on in the story is, naturally, more tangible. I just discovered that the UK made a TV series out of it. Only watched a few episodes but it seems pretty good (yeah, a little dated but what can you expect?) It is chilling to me how real the notion is of the way people are controlled, just as we have seen ourselves, with peer pressure and how they come to accept things. And what I like about it is that the control seems very subtle. More modern or lower skilled story telling would make the differences more overt IMO (like the Borg in Star Trek) but this makes opposition to the force seem more of an obvious choice.
